remediations.guidance: Select a host from the approved Ubuntu Server family and validate its release through the supported-host review.
Approve and record exact Ubuntu Server releases or a compatibility range before enforcing release-specific drift.
Use the currently tested x86_64 architecture or complete a separate compatibility review for another architecture.
Provision an approved Python 3.11 or newer runtime through a separately reviewed bootstrap procedure.
Provide approved Git tooling for repository reconstruction and immutable version management during bootstrap.
Review system-service integration and decide whether systemd becomes a required long-term platform contract.
Select and approve the profile-specific container runtime policy before treating Docker as mandatory.
Restore non-elevated, read-only block capability observation through an approved host-administration procedure.
Restore non-elevated, sanitized mount capability observation through an approved host-administration procedure.
Review whether the selected profile and integrations require a default route; preserve offline or local-only designs where valid.
Choose a component-derived CPU sizing method and validate workloads before approving an enforceable threshold.
Choose a memory sizing method derived from the selected profile and component workload before approving an enforceable threshold.

guidance_by_profile.lab: Choose a memory sizing method derived from selected experimental components; include model workload only when model-runtime is selected.
guidance_by_profile.core: Choose a memory sizing method derived from Kal, Beepy, model-runtime when selected, and other selected Core components.
guidance_by_profile.storage: Choose a memory sizing method derived from selected Storage-role services, backup and retention workload, and filesystem and storage tooling.

remediations.guidance: Choose a local-capacity sizing method derived from the selected profile and component working set before approving an enforceable threshold.

guidance_by_profile.lab: Size the Lab local experimental working set from the selected components before approving an enforceable threshold.
guidance_by_profile.core: Size Core application state and migration or backup staging from selected components and recovery workflow without making Core the retention authority.

remediations.guidance: Size Storage from protected working sets, approved retention, replication, and safety margin before enforcing capacity.
Derive compute requirements from the selected provider and model, then approve profile-specific CPU, memory, GPU, and VRAM policy.

requirements.description: Initial supported production reconstruction targets the Ubuntu Server family.
requirements.reason: The documented fresh-host path names Ubuntu Server; other distribution families have not been validated.

requirements.description: Exact supported Ubuntu Server releases or compatibility range remain unapproved.
requirements.evidence_source: No canonical release compatibility matrix exists.
requirements.reason: Release-specific enforcement requires tested package and runtime compatibility evidence.

requirements.description: x86_64 is the initial tested host architecture; other architectures require compatibility evidence.
requirements.evidence_source: Current canonical platform/application operating environment and Phase 4E architecture observation contract
requirements.reason: No ARM or other architecture compatibility validation is recorded.

requirements.description: Kalvin executable tooling requires Python 3.11 or newer on every profile where the CLI runs.
requirements.reason: This is the Kalvin tooling runtime requirement, not a Kal or Beepy application runtime declaration.

requirements.description: Git is required during repository reconstruction and immutable version management.
requirements.evidence_source: Canonical independent-repository reconstruction and lock contract
requirements.reason: The requirement is bootstrap-time; it does not claim each steady-state service executes Git.

requirements.description: systemd is recommended for the current Ubuntu-oriented service integration but is not yet a permanent platform invariant.
requirements.evidence_source: Ubuntu Server orientation and future service-management design; no operational units exist yet
requirements.reason: A later service implementation must decide whether alternatives are supported.

requirements.description: Docker is observable but no canonical deployment implementation makes it universally mandatory yet.
requirements.evidence_source: Phase 4E observes Docker capability; Phase 4C/4D contain no operational container implementation
requirements.reason: Core and Storage runtime selection must be approved independently; Storage must not inherit Core compute assumptions.

requirements.description: Storage must permit sanitized block-capability observation without elevation.
requirements.evidence_source: Storage backup/retention role and Phase 4E sanitized inventory contract
requirements.reason: This proves observability only; it does not prove capacity, topology, health, or repository readiness.

requirements.description: Storage must permit sanitized mount-capability observation without elevation.
requirements.evidence_source: Storage backup/retention role and Phase 4E sanitized mount contract
requirements.reason: This proves observability only and does not expose mount source or options.

requirements.description: Default-route presence is useful for Core integrations but is not universally mandatory.
requirements.evidence_source: Repository acquisition and outbound backup concepts without a fixed transport topology
requirements.reason: Offline Lab and local-only Storage designs may be valid; no address, DNS, or reachability probe is authorized.

requirements.description: No evidence-backed logical CPU minimum exists.
requirements.evidence_source: No canonical workload benchmark or component sizing contract exists.
requirements.reason: The current host and any planned single machine must not define universal minimums.

requirements.evidence_source: No canonical profile and selected-component memory sizing contract exists.
requirements.reason: Memory must be derived from the selected profile and applicable component workloads rather than one development host.

requirements.description: Local selected-component working-set capacity has no approved numeric minimum.
requirements.evidence_source: Selected profile component working sets and staging policy are not yet quantified.
requirements.reason: Local capacity must reflect selected profile intent without assigning long-term retention authority to Core.

requirements.description: Storage retention capacity must be policy-derived; no universal byte threshold is approved.
requirements.evidence_source: Retention values, replication topology, and protected working-set sizes remain open.
requirements.reason: Capacity should derive from backup working set, retention, replication, and safety margin.

requirements.description: CPU, memory, GPU, and VRAM requirements depend on the selected model provider and model.
requirements.reason: Kalvin must not invent hardware limits or equate the logical component with Ollama or one GPU.
